Medi GmbH & Co. KG
(often styled as
medi
) is a German manufacturer of medical aids, best known for its compression garments and orthopedic supports.

Headquartered in Bayreuth, Germany,
medi GmbH & Co. KG
is a global leader in medical aids, manufacturing high-performance compression stockings, adaptive systems, and orthopedic supports under core brands like
medi
CEP
, and
ITEM m6
Research and Markets
Product Brands & Sub-Brands
medi (Medical):
The flagship medical branch covering phlebology, lymphology, and orthopedics. Key product lines include
mediven
(compression stockings/tights),
circaid
(adjustable compression wraps),
Spinomed
(back braces),
medi footsupport
and
igli
(carbon fiber orthotic insoles), alongside a broad range of joint supports and rigid orthoses.
medi
CEP (Sports):
High-tech sports compression brand for running, endurance, and team sports (socks, sleeves, and sportswear derived from medical compression technology).
iF Design Award
ITEM m6:
Premium fashion and lifestyle legwear brand providing shaping and compression tights, stockings, and casual wear for women.
Tracxn
medi for help:
The corporate social responsibility initiative/charity branch providing prosthetic care and support projects globally.
medi
Strategic & Manufacturer Partnerships
DSV (German Ski Federation):
Official medical supplier and partner to the national ski teams.
medi
GOTS & AGA:
Collaborations with major medical societies including the Gesellschaft für Orthopädisch-Traumatologische Sportmedizin (GOTS) and the Deutsch-Asiatische Gesellschaft / Arthroskopie Arbeitsgemeinschaft (AGA) for scientific fellowships and awards.
medi
eurocom:
Active membership in the European manufacturers' federation for compression therapy and orthopedic devices.
medi
Regional & Clinical Networks:
Partnerships with elite training entities like the Bavarian Olympic Training Centre (OSP) and global regional distributors (such as Pushpanjali medi in India).
